additions.name: Evil Eye Tweaks
additions.reason: Owned mod (minecraft-mods/mods/EvilEyeTweaks fce93f3, private local pin until a canonical release): forced-fuel furnace routing and paired doors/gates/trapdoors (consolidation wave 1), pick-up receipts and food snapshots for Evil Eye Client (wave 2), and attribute limits, pet rules, tree felling, flat bedrock, day length, orb clumping and despawn rules (wave 4); 0.6.1 adds the Slow Falling drop threshold (owner request, not a replacement).; 0.7.0 adds owned cosmetic armour storage (player persistent data, replaces Cosmetic Armor Reworked) and the evileye_tweaks:equipment menu (equipment panel wave). Round-4 owned sorting and physical-storage/Dank transfers complete the bounded IPN replacement; both-hand refill remains enabled. IPN/libIPN removed together, Kotlin retained. Release 2026-11-02: 0.9.0 from minecraft-mods 42406c6; settings screen/service metadata. IPN replacement retained. Paired Stable release: Tweaks 0.10.0 repairs IMC dispatch and admits ordinary/trapped Iron Chests physical storage up to 108 slots; Dirt stays excluded. Inventory sorting negotiates protocol 2. Paired Stable release 2026-11-03: Tweaks 0.11.0 adds optional inventory_transfer_v2 matching transfers alongside compatible v1 ALL; common config is unchanged. Tweaks 0.11.1 (minecraft-mods eef9cc7) reopens the equipment panel when a slot-granting curio (such as the EnderChests Ender Pouch) is equipped or removed instead of closing it; no config or protocol change. Tweaks 0.12.0 (minecraft-mods f63cc0c) adds the server-side evileye_tweaks:equipment_storage menu and optional equipment_storage v1 channel behind the Client 0.12.0 Backpack and Ender tabs (Sophisticated Backpacks, Sophisticated Core and EnderChests: all optional and loader-gated; compiled against Core 1.21.1-1.5.28.2458, Backpacks 1.21.1-3.26.20.2244, EnderChests 1.21.1-1.0). Server and client must both run 0.12.0; no config change. Tweaks 0.13.0 (minecraft-mods bac93d5) adds the Trash Can storage tab (Essentials /trashcan gated, optional equipment_trash v1 channel; no new menu type) and fixes middle-click sort and move-all in the panel and storage tabs; older Clients keep working, no config change. Tweaks 0.14.0 (minecraft-mods be01ed9) adds the optional recipe_fill v1 channel: EMI "+" fills the crafting table and the 2x2 grids from the carried Sophisticated Backpack and Ender Pouch, server-planned and all or nothing; older Clients keep the viewer's own fill; no config change. Tweaks 0.14.1 (minecraft-mods adee41c, merged main) publishes a recipe_fill availability revision to the Client and adds recipe-fill logging and state-to-preview GameTests; no config or protocol change. Tweaks 0.14.3 (minecraft-mods main, folds unreleased 0.14.2) sends carried Dank contents to dedicated-server clients (Building Gadgets 2 preview, optional dank_contents channel, optional dankstorage dependency ordering) and adds recipe-fill menu/request diagnostics; no config change. Tweaks 0.14.4 (minecraft-mods main) makes recipe fill work in the crafting window summoned by an Ars Nouveau spell (the craft glyph; EffectCraft$CustomWorkbench, a CraftingMenu subclass matched by class name, no Ars dependency); server-only, Client 0.15.1 unchanged; no config change.

additions.name: Evil Eye Client
additions.reason: Owned client-only Evil Eye Client 0.15.6, private local pin: the Backpack and Ender storage tabs open inside the equipment panel (Sophisticated Backpacks' own menu; Ender Pouch else Bag grid), and E opens the equipment panel in survival. Requires Tweaks 0.12.0 on server and client for the storage tabs; older Tweaks falls back to the 0.11.x tab squares. Retains the owned client features; no config change. 0.12.1 (minecraft-mods fae25be) lays the Backpack tab out in the panel like Ender and fixes the tab strip going inactive after a switch; no Tweaks, config or protocol change (Tweaks stays 0.12.0). 0.13.0 (minecraft-mods 8c29f61) adds the action rail inside the panel on the Backpack and Ender tabs, the panel Trash Can button and scrolling Attributes & Effects; it needs Tweaks 0.13.0 for the panel trash and rail actions (older Tweaks: the button runs /trashcan, no rail actions on storage tabs). No config change. 0.14.0 (minecraft-mods 7235b0d) routes EMI "+" through Tweaks recipe_fill so recipes fill from the carried backpack and Ender Pouch; it needs Tweaks 0.14.0 (older Tweaks keeps the viewer's own fill). No config change. 0.15.0 (minecraft-mods main, folds unreleased 0.14.1 and 0.14.2) adds the Backpack tab upgrade dock (Sophisticated upgrade slots, switches and tabs inside the panel, four scoped client mixins), removes the info-tab footer and rebuilds EMI's recipe screen when Tweaks' carried availability changes (needs Tweaks 0.14.1). No config change. 0.15.1 (minecraft-mods main) adds recipe-fill handler-choice, preview and request diagnostics (log lines only, no behaviour change); pairs with Tweaks 0.14.3. 0.15.2 (minecraft-mods main b1f0bab) fixes the EMI "+" so an empty Tweaks preview (0 batches) leaves the fill to the selected handler (Dank Recipe Transfer), restoring Dank-only fills; positive previews still go to Tweaks. No config change. 0.15.4 (minecraft-mods main, folds unreleased 0.15.3) makes the Sophisticated upgrade dock full height and moves the settings into the panel; no config change. 0.15.5 (minecraft-mods main 3c2e3e1) clamps the storage panel above the HUD hotbar; no config change. 0.15.6 (minecraft-mods main fd2e0ff) makes the Backpack upgrade slots one contiguous column with a visible settings button and keeps the settings screen inside the panel; no config change. Release history: docs/neoforge-migration.md.

additions.name: FAUNA Engine
additions.reason: Owner request 2026-11-05: HTTYD-style tameable dragons beside Ice and Fire (survey 2026-11-05-dragon-mod-survey; Ice and Fire stays). Creature library required by Book of Dragons (liberanimalium [1.0,)); CurseForge only (project 1766276, file 9327835, liberanimalium-1.0+1.21.1-neoforge.jar). PRIVATE PATCH: stock 1.0 crashes the server at boot because its CraftingLockedRecipeMixin @Redirects ResultContainer.setRecipeUsed in CraftingMenu.slotChangedCraftingGrid, the same call Interstellaris' CraftingMenuMixin (research gate) redirects (Mixin: '@Redirect conflict ... already redirected by interstellaris.mixins.json:CraftingMenuMixin', critical injection failure with defaultRequire 1). The pin removes CraftingLockedRecipeMixin from liberanimalium.neoforge.mixins.json and changes nothing else; FAUNA then no longer hides its own locked recipes in the crafting table grid (CrafterLockedRecipeMixin stays). Revert to the CurseForge pin if either mod ships a fix. Local hash pin, no redistribution URL (personal pack).

additions.name: Book of Dragons
additions.reason: Owner request 2026-11-05: HTTYD-style tameable dragons beside Ice and Fire (survey 2026-11-05-dragon-mod-survey; Ice and Fire stays). 1.4 (2026-10-27) is the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 release; requires AzureLib 3.2.0 and FAUNA Engine 1.0+.

additions.name: Cubes Without Borders
additions.reason: Owner request 2026-11-07: Sodium 0.8.13 has no borderless mode and exclusive fullscreen freezes on alt-tab (driver hang on focus loss, hybrid RTX 4050 + Intel). Client-only; 5.0.0 (2026-10-24, MIT) is the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 release, adds a Borderless/Windowed entry to Sodium and vanilla Video Settings. Shipped config/cwb.json starts the game borderless.
